results.rationale: Consistency: the gray printer and white setting remain recognizable, but the top housing develops a large new feed opening and the rear paper position/size changes. Instruction: a visibly printed document is placed directly in front of the printer as requested. Quality: coherent machine and paper perspective, but the document headline and body contain conspicuous pseudo-text/garbled lettering.

Consistency: the foil-wrapped and nut-coated chocolates remain recognizable, but surface details change and two extra small chocolate spheres are introduced. Instruction: gold gradient, upper-right light and top-left brown title are present, but there are four balls rather than two, the title says 'wortd', and the bold yellow backdrop is less champagne-toned and restrained. Quality: the product forms and reflections are coherent, but the prominent misspelled headline is a clear semantic flaw.
